notes: Identity verified independently: supplied text has matching title Unique Affective Profile of Music-Evoked Nostalgia: An Extension and Conceptual Replication of Barrett et al.’s (2010) Study, authors Sarah Hennessy, Timothy Greer, Shrikanth Narayanan, Assal Habibi, and DOI 10.1037/emo0001389. It is the primary research article (2024 advance online publication), with Methods, Results, Discussion, tables and references through printed p.23; not merely an abstract. No PDF was supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. The requested standardized beta is not established: context variables were raw and not standardized; person scores were mean-centered, not described as standardized. Printed β coefficients and Cohen’s f² candidates are retained without conversion. Positive valence is uniquely identified in the context-only comparison: β=3.94, t(1700)=41.76, adjusted p<.001, Table 4 p.7 and Results p.5. The model predicts positive valence from nostalgia/control song condition; this is a conceptual replication with changed model direction, not the original continuous-nostalgia regression. Narrative f²=0.61 (p.5) and Table 4 f²=0.62 differ; retained β instead. Target_match is false for the literal supplied outcome/test: the source explicitly changes from predictors of continuous nostalgia to categorical nostalgia/control predicting positive valence. The printed coefficient is retained with this mismatch visible, not asserted to be the original-form target regression.
